response.sql: WITH college_counts AS (SELECT c.college_id, NULLIF(TRIM(c.state), '') AS state, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM player_college AS pc JOIN college AS c ON c.college_id = pc.college_id GROUP BY c.college_id, NULLIF(TRIM(c.state), '')), overall AS (SELECT AVG(record_count) AS avg_count, SUM(record_count) AS total_count FROM college_counts) SELECT cc.state, AVG(cc.record_count) AS avg_college_count, AVG(1.0 * cc.record_count / o.avg_count) AS avg_relative_to_overall_average, AVG(1.0 * cc.record_count / o.total_count) AS avg_share_of_total FROM college_counts AS cc CROSS JOIN overall AS o GROUP BY cc.state ORDER BY cc.state;

assumptions.assumption: Each college_id identifies one college record; blank and missing states are grouped together as NULL.
